yaya.plugin.mention.desc: Mention plugins, skills or MCP servers to enable their tools in this conversation
yaya.plugin.mention.docs:
# @ Mentions

Type @ or click the toolbar @ button to search plugins, skills and MCP servers by name, description or tool name. Selecting an item enables its tools for this conversation.

Disabling the mention plugin removes its composer extension. Existing conversation mentions can be revoked from the conversation menu. Mentioning never bypasses tool approval or privacy consent.

yaya.wf.perspectives_desc: Expert, skeptic and pragmatist sub-agents answer in parallel; the main agent synthesizes and verifies with tools when needed. Good for hard questions and choosing approaches
